mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% over 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
